contexts.text: Transgressions () = falsities.
What is my trespass? what is my sin? () = that it was not of evil.
When a husband is conjoined from lust only, he believes himself to have transgressed...
When one is in (what is spiritual) he knows that he transgresses if he benefits a friend who is evil.

Forgive... the transgression of thy brethren, and their sin () = supplication and repentance... Mention is made of both transgression and sin on account of the marriage of truth and good in the Word; for transgression = evil contrary to truth, which is lesser; and sin = evil contrary to good, which is greater. Illustrated.

Upon every word of transgression () = whatever injury and whatever loss; for transgression = everything that is contrary to the truth of faith, thus that which injures and extinguishes it, consequently whatever injury or loss there is of it.

In the Word, evils are now called sins, now iniquities, and now transgressions... Those are called transgressions which take place contrary to the truths of faith... These, and iniquities issue from a perverted understanding. Illustrated.
As transgressions are things which are contrary to the truths of faith, they are also transgressions, and revolts. Illustrated.
That transgression = evil contrary to the truths of faith, is manifestly evident from these words.

He will not bear your transgression () = because these things oppose truths from good; for transgression = the things which are contrary to the truths of faith; thus which are opposed to truths from good, which are the truths of faith.
Therefore to number the sons of Israel was a transgression such as there is with those who chain to themselves the truths of faith and the goods of love, and the ordination and disposition of them.
For all corruption and deviation from duty in worship, is a recession and turning away from the Divine.
Bearing iniquity, transgression, and sin () = the removal of evil and its falsity so that they do not appear.
He was numbered with the transgressors... and made intercession for the transgressors ().
For he who transgresses against one commandment, transgresses against all. Explained. TCR 523.
When one is in anguish on account of transgressions against things which are not true and good...

He was pierced for our transgressions... ()... These words describe the temptations which the Lord underwent in the world in order that He might subjugate the Hells, and reduce all things... into order.
Occurs.
When the transgressors have come to the full () = when there are no longer truth and good, but falsity and evil.
To consummate the transgression and to seal up sins () = when all in the Church are in falsities of doctrine and in evils as to life.
Devastation to them because they have transgressed against Me () = the deprivation of all truth on account of their falling away.
The name of a transgressor was given thee from the womb () = a turning back from truths from the first time when one could be reformed.
Children of transgression, and seed of falsehood () = falsities springing from these prior falsities.
Transgressions which have been multiplied () = falsifications of truth.
Under Sin, see this reference.
